boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on Bellevue Avenue and its connected Ochre Point Avenue corridor, immediately north of Salve Regina’s Newport campus.

cards.title: International Tennis Hall of Fame
cards.subtitle: Bellevue Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk Bellevue Avenue to the historic Newport Casino campus and use the museum’s official visitor information to plan a daytime stop.
cards.short_summary: A tennis museum and historic Newport Casino destination on Bellevue Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The International Tennis Hall of Fame is located at the historic Newport Casino on Bellevue Avenue.
cards.source_title: Visit the International Tennis Hall of Fame
cards.access_notes: Check the institution’s visitor page for current museum access and ticket details.

cards.title: Redwood Library and Athenaeum
cards.subtitle: Bellevue Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Continue north on Bellevue Avenue to see the historic library building; consult its official calendar before attending a public program.
cards.short_summary: A historic library and athenaeum on the Bellevue Avenue approach.
cards.evidence_claim: Redwood Library and Athenaeum is at 50 Bellevue Avenue in Newport.
cards.access_notes: Public access and program availability vary; check the library’s official visitor guidance.

cards.title: Newport Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Bellevue Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the Bellevue Avenue route to reach the museum in the Griswold House and review current exhibitions before you go.
cards.short_summary: An art museum housed in the historic Griswold House on Bellevue Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Newport Art Museum is located at 76 Bellevue Avenue and presents changing exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Review the museum’s official visitor page for current hours, admission, and exhibitions.

cards.title: Kingscote
cards.subtitle: Bellevue Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Pause at the Bellevue Avenue estate and use the Preservation Society’s page to confirm whether house tours are being offered.
cards.short_summary: A Preservation Society historic house on Bellevue Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Kingscote is a Newport Mansions property at 253 Bellevue Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Tour availability is seasonal; confirm access with the official property page.

cards.title: The Elms
cards.subtitle: Bellevue Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Follow Bellevue Avenue to the Berwind estate and choose an available mansion or servant-life tour from the official visitor listing.
cards.short_summary: A 48-room Newport Mansions estate with tours and grounds access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elms is at 367 Bellevue Avenue and offers mansion and servant-life tours.
cards.access_notes: Tickets and open dates vary by season; consult the official property page.

cards.title: Chateau-sur-Mer
cards.subtitle: Bellevue Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Make this Bellevue Avenue estate a photo-and-history stop, then check the Preservation Society page for its current seasonal opening dates.
cards.short_summary: A historic Newport Mansions property on Bellevue Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Chateau-sur-Mer is a Newport Mansions property at 474 Bellevue Avenue.
cards.access_notes: The house is not open continuously; verify dates and ticketing before visiting.

cards.title: Rosecliff
cards.subtitle: Bellevue Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk to Rosecliff on Bellevue Avenue and look for the official tour or exhibition schedule before planning an interior visit.
cards.short_summary: A Bellevue Avenue mansion with tours, exhibitions, and special events.
cards.evidence_claim: Rosecliff is at 548 Bellevue Avenue and hosts tours, exhibitions, and special events.
cards.access_notes: Confirm open dates, exhibitions, and admission through the official property page.

cards.title: Marble House
cards.subtitle: Bellevue Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Continue south on Bellevue Avenue to the Vanderbilt estate and review the official listing for mansion tours and tea-house service.
cards.short_summary: A Vanderbilt-era mansion and social-history landmark on Bellevue Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Marble House is at 596 Bellevue Avenue and offers tours, special events, and tea service.
cards.access_notes: Interior access requires admission; confirm current hours and ticket availability online.

cards.title: Rough Point
cards.subtitle: Bellevue Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use Bellevue Avenue to reach the Doris Duke estate and consult the museum’s official page for tour dates and visitor information.
cards.short_summary: The Doris Duke estate and museum at the southern Bellevue Avenue end.
cards.evidence_claim: Rough Point Museum is at 680 Bellevue Avenue in Newport.
cards.access_notes: Museum visitation is seasonal; check the official site before traveling there.

cards.title: The Breakers
cards.subtitle: Ochre Point Avenue corridor, off Bellevue Avenue
cards.notes: Turn from Bellevue Avenue onto Ochre Point Avenue for the Vanderbilt estate; use the official page to reserve a timed mansion visit.
cards.short_summary: A 70-room Vanderbilt mansion on the Ochre Point Avenue branch of the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Breakers is at 44 Ochre Point Avenue and offers mansion and grounds tours.
cards.access_notes: Timed tickets may be required; verify current opening dates and admission on the official page.
